translation.name: Luda yã takada kũ Bisã yão

content: Esekiɑsi
u Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑru seeyɑ

Yenibɑ kpuron biru, Isireli be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ mi, bɑ seewɑ bɑ dɑ Yudɑn wusu kpuro sɔɔ bɑ bwɑ̃ɑrokunu kɔsukɑ mɑ bɑ gungunu kɑ bũu yɑ̃ku yenu kpuro kɔsukɑ Yudɑn temɔ kɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛn temɔ kɑ Efɑrɑimun temɔ kɑ Mɑnɑsen temɔ. Yen biru, be kpuro bɑ wurɑmɑ ben temɔ, ben bɑɑwure u dɑ u wɑ̃ɑ win wɑ̃ɑ yerɔ.

Esekiɑsi u wure u yɑ̃ku kowobu kɑ Lefibɑ wesiɑ ben sɔmburu sɔɔ nge mɛ bɑ kɑ bɔnu sɑ̃ɑ kɑ sɔmbu te bɑɑwure u rɑ ko. Berɑ bɑ ko n dɑ yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑruginu kɑ siɑrɑbun yɑ̃kunu ko kɑ sere womusu bu kɑ Yinni Gusunɔ siɑrɑ win sɑ̃ɑ yerun kɔnnɔwɔ.

Sinɑ boko Esekiɑsi u win dukiɑn sukum wɛ̃ bu kɑ yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑruginu ko ni bɑ rɑ ko bururu kɑ yokɑ kɑ ni bɑ rɑ ko tɔ̃ɔ wɛ̃rɑrugiru sɔɔ kɑ suru kpɑon tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru sɔɔ kɑ sere tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑ ni nu tie sɔɔ nge mɛ bɑ yoruɑ woodɑn tireru sɔɔ.
Yerɑ u Yerusɑlɛmugibu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bu yɑ̃ku kowobu kɑ Lefibɑ ben bɑɑ wɛ̃ɛyɔ, kpɑ bu kpĩ bu Yinni Gusunɔn woodɑbɑ mɛm nɔɔwɑ sɑ̃ɑ sɑ̃ɑ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ gɑri yi, yi nɔɔrɑ bɑɑmɑ, yerɑ Isirelibɑ bɑ ben ɑlikɑmɑ ye yɑ gbiɑ yɑ ye wɛ̃ kɑ tɑm kpɑm kɑ gum kɑ tim kɑ sere ben dĩɑnu gɑnu. Mɛyɑ bɑ mɑɑ kɑ gɑ̃ɑnu kpuron wɔkuru bɑɑteren wɔllɔn tiɑ tiɑ nɑ.
Mɛyɑ Isirelibɑ kɑ Yudɑbɑ be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Yudɑn wuu mɑrosɔ bɑ ben yɑɑ sɑbenun wɔkuru bɑɑteren wɔllɔn tiɑ tiɑ wɛ̃ kɑ sere gɑ̃ɑ ni bɑ gɔsɑ bɑ yi nɛnɛm Yinni Gusunɔn sɔ̃. Mɑ bɑ nu subɑ subɑ.
Bɑ nin subenu toruɑwɑ sɑɑ wɔ̃ɔn suru itɑsen di n kɑ dɑ wɔ̃ɔ gen suru nɔɔbɑ yiruse sɔɔ.
Esekiɑsi kɑ win sinɑ bwɑ̃ɑbu bɑ nɑ bɑ subu ni wɑ, yerɑ bɑ Yinni Gusunɔ kɑ win tɔmbu siɑrɑ.
Mɑ Esekiɑsi u yɑ̃ku kowobu kɑ Lefi be bikiɑ u nɛɛ, subu nirɑ̀ mini.

Yerɑ yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwero Asɑriɑ, Sɑdɔkun bweseru sɔɔ, u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, sɑɑ mìn di bɑ kɑ kɛ̃nu nɑɑmɔ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ, dĩɑnu rɑ n wɑ̃ɑwɑ sɑ n dimɔ, sɑ n debumɔ. Ni nu tiɑrɑ nu kpɑ̃ niyɑ mini. Domi Yinni Gusunɔ u sun domɑru kuɑ.
Mɑ Esekiɑsi u woodɑ wɛ̃ bu dinu sɔmɛ mi bɑ koo nu yi. Mɑ bɑ dinu sɔnwɑ.
Mɑ bɑ kɑ kɛ̃nu kɑ wɔkuru bɑɑteren wɔllɔn tiɑ tiɑ nɑ kɑ yɑ̃ku dĩɑ ni nu sɑ̃ɑ Yinni Gusunɔginu. Lefi wi bɑ mɔ̀ Konɑniɑ wiyɑ bɑ dĩɑ ni nɔmu sɔndiɑ, mɑ win mɛro bisi Simɛi u sɑ̃ɑ win yiruse.

Yeyɛli kɑ Asɑsiɑ kɑ Nɑkɑti kɑ Asɑɛli kɑ Yerimɔti kɑ Yosɑbɑdi kɑ Eliɛli kɑ Yisimɑkiɑ kɑ Mɑkɑti kɑ Bɛnɑyɑ be kpurowɑ Konɑniɑ kɑ win mɛro bisi Simɛi bɑ kpɑre nge mɛ sinɑ boko Esekiɑsi kɑ yɑ̃ku kowo Asɑriɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerun wirugii bɑ woodɑ wɛ̃.

Kore wi u sɑ̃ɑ Lefi Yiminɑn bii, u sɑ̃ɑwɑ kɔnnɔ ge gɑ wɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru giɑn kɔ̃so. Wiyɑ bɑ kɛ̃ɛ ni nɔmu sɔndiɑ nì bɑ kɑ Yinni Gusunɔ nɑɑwɑ kɑ nuku tiɑ kɑ sere ni bɑ rɑ wunɛ Yinni Gusunɔn sɔ̃. Beyɑ bɑ ko n dɑ kɛ̃ɛ ni bɔnu ko.

Yɑ̃ku kowobun wusu sɔɔ, Edɛni kɑ Miyɑmini kɑ Yosue kɑ Semɑyɑ kɑ Amɑriɑ kɑ Sekɑniɑwɑ bɑ gɔsɑ bu Kore wi somi bɑ n dɑ kɑ kɛ̃ɛ ni begibu bɔnu kue dee dee bibu kɑ bukurobu kpuro nge mɛ bɑ kɑ bu bɔnu sɑ̃ɑ wuu wuukɑ.
Beyɑ tɔn durɔ bii be bɑ gɑrɑ sɑɑ wɔ̃ɔ itɑn di n kɑ dɑ be bɑ kere mɛ, kɑ be bɑ gesi dumɔ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ tɔ̃ɔ bɑɑtere bu kɑ ben sɔmɑ ko wuu wuukɑ,
kɑ yɑ̃ku kowo be bɑ gɑrɑ yɛnu kɑ yɛnu kɑ Lefibɑ be bɑ gɑrɑ sɑɑ be bɑ wɔ̃ɔ yɛndu mɔn di nge mɛ ben sɔmburɑ sɑ̃ɑ wuu wuukɑ,
kɑ sere mɑɑ tɔn be bɑ tie kpuro kɑ ben debuminu kɑ ben kurɔbu kɑ bii tɔn durɔbu kɑ tɔn kurɔbu, domi bɑ tii wɛ̃wɑ mɑm mɑm Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerun sɔmburu sɔɔ.
Aronin bibun bweseru te tɑ sɑ̃ɑ yɑ̃ku kowobu bɑru kpɑɑnɔ wuu mɑrosun bɔkuɔ, bɑ tɔmbu gɔsɑ wuu bɑɑgere sɔɔ be bɑ ko n dɑ bu dĩɑnu bɔnu kue ben suunu sɔɔ, kɑ sere Lefi be bɑ gɑrɑ gɑrɑn suunu sɔɔ.
Wee ye Esekiɑsi u kuɑ Yudɑ kpuro sɔɔ. U sĩɑwɑ dee dee gem sɔɔ Gusunɔ win Yinnin wuswɑɑɔ.
Sɔmɑ ye u kuɑ bu kɑ sɑ̃ɑru ko Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ kɑ sere win woodɑn mɛm nɔɔbu, u ye kpuro kuɑwɑ kɑ gɔ̃ru tiɑ. Mɑ u koorɑ.
Asirin sinɑ boko Sɑnkeribu
u Yudɑn tem wɔri
